discovery_notes: DLR open edition 2025-2026 pass. 32 WebSearch queries, all search_snippet (search summaries). Mostly WDWNT and Disney Pins Blog. Many 'DLR' OE items are shared Disneyland+WDW releases; release_location records what source said. 2025 dated pins arrived Nov 2024. Conflicts kept: 70th booster characters (WDWNT vs MickeyBlog); Mater OE vs LE wording; HM Holiday 2026 $17.99 OE vs $21.99 LR; Inquisitor vs Darth Maul lightsaber; Pinocchio book $9.99 (DL) vs $14.99 elsewhere. Pumpkin Pals location only 'Disney Parks'. 2026 boosters (Villains/Princes/Sidekicks) dating tentative. | Key fix 2026-10-16: 65 single-pin set keys renamed from <pin_key> to .../oe-single/<slug> (set key must differ from pin key).
